paras: Application: Honda Civic Type R FK8 / FL5 and Acura Integra Type S DE5 (K20C1) Part Type: Port injection kit – adapter plate and fuel rail Part Number: 20-0428

The Radium Port Injection Kit (PIK) adds a bank of port fuel injectors to the direct-injected Honda K20C1. The kit installs between the intake manifold and the cylinder head, supplying the additional fuel that high-horsepower K20C1 builds need. It does not replace the OEM direct injection system – it works alongside it – and it is compatible with all fuel types including E85 and other alcohol blends.
hl: Supplements OEM Injection: Adds port injection while retaining the factory direct injection system
Four 8AN ORB Ports: All rail ports tapped 8AN ORB (3/4"-16) for fittings, regulators, dampers or gauges
Extruded 6063 Aluminium Rail: CNC-machined with a 16mm (0.63in) internal bore and laser-etched finish
Correct Spray Angle: Injectors are set at a specific angle to target the intake ports
Thermal Isolation: Insulating spacers and washers isolate the rail from cylinder head heat
Fuel Compatibility: Suits all fuel types including E85 and other alcohol blends
ft: Radium Engineering Port Injection Fuel Rail Kit for Honda Civic Type-R FK8 17-21/FL5 2022+
